title: Pinyni Ok Thurwa Mwageno
author: We ve No Abiding City Here
stanzas: Pinyni ok thurwa mwageno; Waonge dala mosiko;
To wachni ohoyo chunywa, Wakiyo dala mabiro, Wakiyo dala mabiro.
Pinyni ok thurwa mwageno; Wakiyo dala ma ok nen;
Zayun e nyinge dala Ruoth; Orieny gi ler ma nyaka chieng`, Orieny gi ler ma nyaka chieng`.
Dala maber mar mor gi kuwe; Kar hawi chandruok onge chuth;
Da an gi buomb winyo koro, Daringi mond` ayue kanyo, Daringi mond` ayue kanyo.
Chunya, kuwe mos! Ruoth ong`eyo, Ndalo ma iniyud yueyo;
E piny ka mond` atim chikne, Ka pod arito ndalono, Ka pod arito ndalono.
